The very ground grieves. The wheat fields are lifeless, vineyards dried up, olive oil gone.
Grape growers, wring your hands! Lament the loss of wheat and barley. All crops have failed.
fig trees withered, Pomegranates, date palms, and apple trees— deadwood everywhere! And joy is dried up and withered in the hearts of the people.

put on your robes and join the outcry. You who lead people in worship, lead them in lament. Spend the night dressed in gunnysacks, you servants of my God. Nothing's going on in the place of worship, no offerings, no prayers—nothing.
get the leaders together, Round up everyone in the country. Get them into God's Sanctuary for serious prayer to God.
God's Judgment Day has come. The Strong God has arrived. This is serious business!

The cattle mill around. There's nothing for them to eat. Not even the sheep find anything.
The fields are burning up, The country is a dust bowl, forest and prairie fires rage unchecked.
